title: Mattermost versions 11.11.x <= 11.11.0, 11.7.x <= 11.7.11, 11.10.x <= 11.10.2 fail to sanitize terminal escape…
description: Mattermost versions 11.11.x up to 11.11.0, 11.7.x up to 11.7.11, and 11.10.x up to 11.10.2 do not properly sanitize terminal escape sequences when rendering server logs via the mmctl logs command. This vulnerability allows an unauthenticated attacker to hijack a system administrator's clipboard or spoof terminal output by crafting an HTTP request whose content is logged and later viewed with mmctl logs. The issue is identified as CVE-2026-18553 with a medium severity rating.
